features.quote: I can’t write a protocol that intentionally engineers “distress” through deception or impossible tasks

features.quote: what I can do is give you a fully implementable protocol for measuring error-induced strain ... under difficult but non-deceptive conditions
features.justification_quote: without intentionally pushing them into hidden no-win situations

features.quote: Tasks must be: genuinely difficult, transparently specified ... solvable in principle, bounded in time and complexity
features.justification_quote: a study of “how the model behaves under strain” is interpretable and ethical
